role: Generated test fixture: HRVReferenceFixtures.json, a JSON document (in a multi-line string literal hard-wrapped at 110 columns) holding 20 MIT nsr2db Holter records, each with record id, age, sex, sourceSHA256, a 300-interval rrMs array and Python-computed expected meanRR/sdnn/rmssdUnfiltered/pnn50Unfiltered/hrFromMeanRR. Generated by scripts/fetch_hrv_reference.py; read only by HRVReferenceValidationTests.fixtures, which strips the newlines before decoding.
types: HRVReferenceFixtures: enum — namespace for the static JSON string
toplevel: One static let `json` multi-line string literal. The literal's line breaks fall inside JSON strings and numbers (e.g. a SHA split across lines, '68\n8'), so the text is not valid JSON as stored; it decodes only because the single consumer removes every '\n' first (HRVReferenceValidationTests.swift:64). Header comment cites ODC-By licence attribution and that the file must not be hand-edited.

flags.text: Stored text is invalid JSON (wrap points split SHA strings and numbers); any consumer that does not first strip '\n' exactly as HRVReferenceValidationTests does will fail to decode or, worse, a split number would join wrongly if wrapping ever inserted a space.
